overall_reason: The idea is 'the file you just added is the subject': 'Launch deck.pdf · Just now · 4.2 MB' is the one real, highlighted row and the rest recede to placeholders.

score.reason: T-ONE-SENTENCE and T-SIGNATURE pass and T-BOLD-MOVE passes on the highlighted row; at 375 the window runs past the stage and cuts the size.
